recommendation.basis: Largest observed unsupported browser-language audience in both 28 and 90 day GA4 periods. Not a claim of largest SEO market or exact number of registered players.

ga4.source: Google Analytics 4 rendered demographic report, directly observed by root agent
metricsNotes: Active users are the GA metric, not registered accounts, native speakers or confirmed game participants.
Browser language is a proxy for localization opportunity. English browser settings can conceal other spoken languages.
Do not sum nested 28/90 day windows or language rows as unique humans; GA client identities and changing browser language can affect deduplication.
Engagement is accumulated per active user for the selected period; it is not mean session length or proof of a completed game.
A missing language row is not a measured zero for all speakers.

humanGameComplete.coverageLimitation: Tracking was added in commit 71fb8a9b on 2026-10-14 16:14:12 +0500, with fixes 9f3e6b4d at 17:07:25. The 28-day date selection is not 28 days of game-event history; absent Vietnamese completions cannot establish absence of Vietnamese players during that period. Deployment time and exact first recorded event timestamp were not independently determined.

gsc.source: Google Search Console UI official CSV export
limitations: Country is country of searcher, not language preference.
Clicks measure Google organic search exposure, not active players.
Last full available report ends 2026-10-11; does not contain 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-14.
gsc.provenance: Official CSV export collected before the rolling UI report later advanced; this fixed saved period is used throughout. Native Vietnamese query demand must not be inferred from country clicks.

rootSelectedObservations.source: Ahrefs Free Keyword Generator, observed live via browser
rootSelectedObservations.selection: Selected relevant observations from root-agent captures; not a complete export of all suggestions.
limitations: Ranges are copied literally, are not exact numbers, and must not be summed.
Market is the chosen Google country, not the whole language.
Head terms including avalon spiel, avalon online, avalon jeu and อวาลอน remain potentially ambiguous; game/rules modifiers narrow intent.
Empty results without an explicit no-data notice are incomplete captures, not zero.

parallelObservations.metric: provider estimated average monthly searches for Google country; raw free tiers only
caveats: Collected 2026-10-15. Exact capture clock for earlier individual rows not retained; capturedAt has day precision.
Volume is a provider estimate, not Google exact searches or traffic forecast. Exact rolling 12-month window not shown.
Country does not equal language. Turkey English-title searches and Vietnam boardgame loanword queries do not measure all native formulations.
No ranking within <100; do not sum keywords or overlapping variants. No keyword-idea counts used as demand.
Updated is literal card freshness, not measurement window. Empty cells preserved as null. KD not exposed after signup prompt preserved as null.

A Cloudflare CAPTCHA appeared for Netherlands avalon spel. It was not solved or bypassed; NL metrics unavailable. Native Vietnamese luật chơi/cách chơi/online and short Japanese/Korean variants not measured before CAPTCHA.
Search results were used qualitatively to disambiguate Avalon the boardgame from myth, Tainted Grail, King of Avalon, DOS games, casino slots and unrelated products.
